title: Thrombophilia tests
what: This is a group of blood tests from a vein. They check whether you have a higher tendency to form blood clots.
why: After blood clots, especially at a young age; after repeated miscarriages; or before hormone pills or IVF if clots run in the family.
duration: the blood draw takes 5 to 10 minutes; results usually come in 3 to 14 days
tell_doctor: If you take hormones or birth control
If you are pregnant or recently gave birth
If you recently had a blood clot or surgery

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: Some tests give false results right after a clot, during pregnancy, or on certain medicines. Your doctor chooses when to test.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually fasting, 8 to 12 hours without food. Water is fine. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Never stop blood thinners on your own. Tell your doctor. They will decide.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: No alcohol and no hard workouts. Do not smoke in the morning.

bring: Past clotting test results, if you have them
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tightened above your elbow, and the skin is wiped
Blood is drawn into several tubes
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
after: Press the cotton pad longer if you take blood thinners
Genetic tests are done once in a lifetime. Other tests are sometimes repeated after 12 weeks
Discuss the results with your doctor, a hematologist or a gynecologist

faq.q: A thrombophilia gene variant was found. Is it dangerous?
faq.a: Many of these variants are common and raise the risk only a little. Your doctor will explain what it means for you.
Some antibodies appear for a short time after an infection. If the result is confirmed after 12 weeks, it matters.

reminders.text: Thrombophilia tests tomorrow. Do not eat after dinner. Do not stop blood thinners on your own.
